plan-review-convergence.md.reason: #3899: the REVIEWS.md lookup was one line of unquoted `$(ls ... 2>/dev/null)` that silently resolved to the empty string on a path with a space, and to a sibling phase's file on a path with a glob metacharacter. Replacing it costs five lines the single line did not carry: a quoted direct assignment, a fail-closed `[ -f ] || [ -r ]` guard, and an error naming the expected location instead of blaming the review agent. The surrounding prose gained one clause saying why the quoting is load-bearing, because this is the shape that regresses when someone 'simplifies' it back to an `ls`.
